main.description: P16 step 3 of com.etzhayyim.apps.mangaka.composeCharacterVrm. Runs CharacterGen (PKU, SIGGRAPH 2024, MIT) on the VKE render pool to turn a single anime reference image + prompt pack into 4–6 view-consistent A-pose images. Self-hosted on `ghcr.io/etzhayyim/character-gen:0.1` (open-weight, no external API). ADR-2605082000 §2 — kind='mcp_tool'. SSoT: lg_mangaka.tools:tool_generate_multiview_anime.

referenceImageB64.description: Base64-encoded PNG of the character reference.

prompts.description: Prompt pack from build_prompt LLM: {pose_prompt, style_prompt, negative_prompt}.

multiviewImages.description: Base64 PNG strings, front / back / left / right (and optional 3-quarter views).
